purpose: A machine-readable statement of what a paid FinanceRateCalc run covers, what it costs, what we keep, and what a client is authorising. Published in the shape of an agent payment mandate so that it can be read by a procurement team, a risk committee, or an agent framework — without requiring any of them.

conditional_entity_screen.description: Full peer-adjusted screen of a submitted public LEI list, returned as a hash-linked Evidence Brief.

quarterly_monitor.description: The same LEI list re-run each quarter against a new analysis layer.

quarterly_layers.2027Q2: 2026 HMDA vintage with a year-over-year delta

data_handling.rejected_input_handling: Rejected before processing and not stored.
data_handling.data_retention: none — submitted lists are not retained after a response is produced
data_handling.sent_to_payment_processor: an opaque request id only; never the LEI list

receipt.result_commitment: A hash of the full result is returned with the free preview, so a client can verify after purchase that the paid result was not altered.

billing_integrity.idempotency: Identical job (same licence, same LEI set, same model version) returns the prior result and is not charged again.
billing_integrity.quota_exceeded: Requests above the per-run cap are refused before any charge.
billing_integrity.delivery_failure: If a payment succeeds and a receipt cannot be produced, the run is refunded in full on request; report it to ziyetis@gmail.com with the request id.

what_is_never_sold: lender recommendations or rankings for a borrower
any figure to a lender covered in the screen
independence: No lender, vendor or AI company funds this work. We accept no payment from any institution appearing in the screen, and every paying client is disclosed in a public register. Published figures are corrected only through the public corrections log; they cannot be bought, moved or removed.
boundaries: Not evidence of misconduct, discrimination, causation or legal violation.
Never a prediction about an individual application.
HMDA contains no credit scores; the expectation is a mix proxy, not a risk model.
future_payment_rails: If per-call agent payment is added (x402 or an equivalent), these same caps, retention rules and human-approval requirements apply unchanged. An agent may relay an offer; it may not authorise a purchase.
